findings.value: The hire site describes the Number 90 Lock room, which it calls its largest, as step-free with loading access; it does not say this of the other spaces. Other access needs: contact the events team. Accessible parking in the private car park can be pre-arranged.

evidence.quote: Step-free, with loading access and flexible crew timings
our largest venue, favoured by event producers
Please contact our team directly to discuss any specific accessibility needs.
accessible parking can be pre-arranged with our team.

notes: Editor: the bar's own site (www.number90bar.co.uk) is the venue's website; the hire site number90corporate.co.uk is the same business. Whole-venue capacity is not stated. Room figures only: Number 90 Lock 180 seated / 650 standing (corporate Lock page, dated 16 Jul 2026). The bar's venue hire page, which still uses the old name Studio 9294, says 'up to 1000 people standing capacity' for corporate events; left out as unclear. No accessible toilet or hearing loop is stated on any page read. Step-free is stated for the Lock room only, so the venue-wide step_free is not set.
